title: Color Palette
slide_intent: Assign colors distinct jobs so designers preserve recognition while providing contrast and supporting detail.
strategic_value: A dominant magenta field with subordinate neutral and berry colors can maintain T-Mobile’s visual continuity.
demonstration: A large magenta swatch dominates the page beside black and white, with smaller berry and gray swatches below.
practical_value: Select a color by its primary, secondary or tertiary role and preserve the specified color workflow.

content_islands.name: Role and production notes
content_islands.spec: List primary, secondary, tertiary roles and RGB/CMYK profile guidance at left.

content_islands.name: Dominant magenta
content_islands.spec: Use the largest swatch for magenta with its print and screen values.

content_islands.name: Supporting palette
content_islands.spec: Place black and white to the right and berry/dark gray/light gray in smaller bottom cells.

ingredient.name: Magenta palette hierarchy
ingredient.role: Establish brand recognition while neutrals provide balance.
ingredient.application: Use magenta #E20074 as primary; black and white support it. Restrict berry and grays to accents and shading, not large fields.
ingredient.scope: Brand communications covered by the February 2024 guide. Tertiary colors are primarily for owned environments. Swatch areas show hierarchy, not a numerical usage ratio.

reference_purposes.Intent: The role descriptions explain magenta as a source of consistency and black and white as support that preserves its vibrancy.
reference_purposes.Expression: The palette presents a dominant magenta swatch with black, white, berry and gray companions.
reference_purposes.Application: Primary, secondary and tertiary labels assign color roles; the profile note identifies the working, saving and export color spaces.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Tertiary colors are restricted to accents and shading and explicitly excluded from large color fields.
